meta.name: airunway-aks-setup
meta.description: Set up AI Runway on AKS — from bare cluster to running model. Covers cluster verification, controller install, GPU assessment, provider setup, and first deployment. WHEN: "setup AI Runway", "onboard AKS cluster", "install AI Runway", "airunway setup", "deploy model to AKS", "GPU inference on AKS", "KAITO setup on AKS", "run LLM on AKS", "vLLM on AKS", "set up model serving on AKS", "AI Runway controller".

copy.tagline_en: Deploy AI Runway onto an AKS cluster in minutes

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按步骤引导你在已有 AKS 集群上部署 AI 模型。它依次检查集群健康、安装 AI Runway 控制器、评估 GPU 兼容性、选择和安装推理提供商,最后部署第一个模型并验证状态。
howto.when: 当用户提到“setup AI Runway”“install AI Runway”等关键词,或要求部署模型到 AKS 时触发;若无现成集群,会先转交 azure-kubernetes 技能。

say.text: 帮我在这个 AKS 集群上设置 AI Runway。
say.note: Claude 会从验证集群开始逐步安装。

say.text: 我想在 AKS 上部署一个 LLM,用 KAITO 提供商。
say.note: 它会评估 GPU 后安装 KAITO 并部署模型。

say.text: 跳过前两步,从 GPU 评估开始继续设置。
say.note: 使用 skip-to-step 参数跳到指定步骤。

howto.what_en: After this skill is loaded, Claude will guide you through setting up AI Runway on an existing AKS cluster: verify the cluster, install the controller, assess GPU compatibility, install an inference provider, and deploy your first model.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to set up AI Runway, install AI Runway, deploy a model to AKS, or similar requests. Assumes an existing AKS cluster; otherwise hands off to the azure-kubernetes skill.
